wholePhysicalScope: The 12-vertex standing palace way names Gedung Induk Istana Kepresidenan Cipanas, matches Wikidata Q12486833 and aligns the projecting entrance with the documented front lawn. This is the original main residence rather than a neighboring pavilion.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the cross-shaped villa, hipped roof ranges and raised verandas. Near levels add the eleven-step approach, leaded side screens and porch columns.
limitations: Exterior reconstruction. Exact roof angles, exterior window spacing, ridge and porch details, glazing and rear elevations are approximate. The original mid-nineteenth-century drawing establishes the broad historic form.
Covers the main residence only. Gedung Bentol, the pavilions, the baths, landscaped grounds and interiors are outside this model.
